description: Olungereza lwe lulimi lw’eggwanga mu Uganda: mu masomero, mu ofiisi ne mu mawulire, era lwogerwa mu nsi nnyingi.
notes: Drafted by Claude from the en-lg course: the English and the Luganda both need a native-speaker review. All 40 units follow the en-lg outline, built with scripts/flip-course.js plus hand-written Luganda.

why.title: Olulimi lw’**essomero n’omulimu.**
why.text: Olungereza lwe lulimi lw’eggwanga mu Uganda. Lukozesebwa mu masomero, mu kkooti, mu ofiisi ne ku yintaneti. Luyige osobole okusoma, okufuna omulimu, n’okwogera n’abantu okuva mu nsi yonna.

cards.title: Ku ssomero
cards.text: Tegeera abasomesa n’ebitabo, era oyitire waggulu mu bigezo.

cards.title: Ku mulimu
cards.text: Wandiika, yogera era okole n’abantu ab’enjawulo n’obwesige.

cards.title: Mu nsi yonna
cards.text: Yogera n’abagenyi, otambule era osome ku yintaneti.

landing.farewell: Thank you very much — weebale nnyo.
landing.audience: Aboogera Oluganda abaagala okuyiga Olungereza okuva ku ntandikwa: abayizi, abakozi, n’abazadde abaagala okuyamba abaana baabwe ku ssomero.
landing.first: Okulamusa, okweyanjula n’ennamba, oluvannyuma ab’omu maka, emmere, akatale, obudde, ebifo, awaka n’obulamu, ekitundu ku kitundu.
